query:
SELECT gm.groupid AS "groupid!"
              FROM groupmembers gm
              INNER JOIN groupchannels jg ON jg.groupid = gm.groupid
             WHERE gm.userid = $1
               AND gm.deleteat = 0
               AND jg.channelid = $2
               AND jg.deleteat = 0
               AND jg.schemeadmin = TRUE
